mapper.sql: CASE WHEN NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN sh.status = 'SENDING' THEN ( SELECT (COUNT(*) * 100.0) / sh.total_target_count FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ELSE (NVL(sh.success_count, 0) * 100.0) / sh.total_target_count END
mapper.select:
SELECT sh.id, sh.scheduled_at, sh.title, sh.purpose, NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) AS total_target_count, CASE WHEN sh.status = 'SENDING' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ELSE NVL(sh.success_count, 0) END AS success_count, CASE WHEN sh.status = 'SENDING' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status IN ('FAILED', 'SKIPPED') AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ELSE NVL(sh.fail_count, 0) END AS fail_count, AS success_rate, sh.estimated_saving, sh.status FROM send_history sh
ORDER BY
sh.scheduled_at ASC NULLS LAST, sh.id ASC
NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) DESC, sh.scheduled_at DESC NULLS LAST, sh.id DESC
DESC, sh.scheduled_at DESC NULLS LAST, sh.id DESC
sh.scheduled_at DESC NULLS LAST, sh.id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT sh.id AS send_history_id, sh.title, sh.content, sh.scheduled_at, sh.purpose, sh.status, NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) AS total_target_count, CASE WHEN sh.status = 'SENDING' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ELSE NVL(sh.success_count, 0) END AS success_count, CASE WHEN sh.status = 'SENDING' THEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status IN ('FAILED', 'SKIPPED') AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ELSE NVL(sh.fail_count, 0) END AS fail_count, CASE WHEN sh.status = 'SENDING' THEN ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(c.cost_per_msg, 0)), 0) FROM send_target st JOIN send_attempt sa ON sa.send_target_id = st.id AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND sa.is_succeeded = 1 JOIN channel c ON c.id = sa.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ELSE NVL(sh.actual_cost, 0) END AS actual_cost, CASE WHEN sh.status = 'SENDING' THEN ( SELECT NVL(SUM(GREATEST(NVL(st.cost, 0) - NVL(c.cost_per_msg, 0), 0)), 0) FROM send_target st JOIN send_attempt sa ON sa.send_target_id = st.id AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND sa.is_succeeded = 1 JOIN channel c ON c.id = sa.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ELSE NVL(sh.estimated_saving, 0) END AS estimated_saving, AS success_rate, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(su.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(su.is_clicked, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(su.id) END FROM short_url su JOIN send_target st ON st.id = su.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND su.purpose IN ('CLICK', 'PURCHASE') AND NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) AS click_rate, ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(su.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(su.is_converted, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / COUNT(su.id) END FROM short_url su JOIN send_target st ON st.id = su.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND su.purpose = 'PURCHASE' AND NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) AS conversion_rate FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0

WITH attempt_orders AS ( SELECT DISTINCT sa.attempt_order FROM send_attempt sa JOIN send_target st ON st.id = sa.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), attempt_counts AS ( SELECT sa.attempt_order, sa.channel_id, COUNT(sa.id) AS request_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.is_succeeded = 1 THEN 1 END) AS success_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN sa.is_succeeded = 0 THEN 1 END) AS fail_count FROM send_attempt sa JOIN send_target st ON st.id = sa.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY sa.attempt_order, sa.channel_id ), display_channels AS ( SELECT channel_id, MIN(sort_order) AS sort_order FROM ( SELECT shr.channel_id, MIN(shr.priority_order) AS sort_order FROM send_history_routing shr WHERE shr.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(shr.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY shr.channel_id UNION ALL SELECT sa.channel_id, 999 AS sort_order FROM send_attempt sa JOIN send_target st ON st.id = sa.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND sa.channel_id IS NOT NULL AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) GROUP BY channel_id ) SELECT ao.attempt_order AS attempt_order, c.channel_type AS channel_name, NVL(ac.request_count, 0) AS request_count, NVL(ac.success_count, 0) AS success_count, NVL(ac.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count FROM attempt_orders ao CROSS JOIN display_channels dc JOIN channel c ON c.id = dc.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN attempt_counts ac ON ac.attempt_order = ao.attempt_order AND ac.channel_id = dc.channel_id ORDER BY ao.attempt_order ASC, dc.sort_order ASC, c.channel_type ASC
SELECT id, channel_type AS label FROM channel WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY channel_type
SELECT id, name AS label FROM tag WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT DISTINCT purpose FROM send_history WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND purpose IS NOT NULL ORDER BY purpose

mapper.select: SELECT sh.id FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.status = 'SENDING' AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(sh.total_target_count, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = sh.id AND st.status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING') AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ) ORDER BY sh.id ASC FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE send_history sh SET status = #{status}, success_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND st.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), fail_count = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND st.status IN ('FAILED', 'SKIPPED') AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), estimated_cost = ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(st.cost, 0)), 0) FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND st.status = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), actual_cost = ( SELECT NVL(SUM(NVL(c.cost_per_msg, 0)), 0) FROM send_target st JOIN send_attempt sa ON sa.send_target_id = st.id AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND sa.is_succeeded = 1 JOIN channel c ON c.id = sa.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), estimated_saving = ( SELECT NVL(SUM(GREATEST(NVL(st.cost, 0) - NVL(c.cost_per_msg, 0), 0)), 0) FROM send_target st JOIN send_attempt sa ON sa.send_target_id = st.id AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND sa.is_succeeded = 1 JOIN channel c ON c.id = sa.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ), completed_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE sh.id = #{sendHistoryId} AND sh.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM send_target st WHERE st.send_history_id = #{sendHistoryId} AND st.status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING') AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 )
